note: Coverage fragment for the AI, ML and LLM pack, written by the waveB-ai-ml-llm lane. It has been imported: registry/coverage.json carries the AI-ML-and-LLM-development row with status built, and evidence_sources there lists EV-0242 to EV-0268, the ids the ledger assigned when packs/ai-ml-llm/research/sources.fragment.json was imported. This file is kept as the frozen record of what the lane proposed. The fragment ids below are that lane's local namespace and are not citable outside this file.

row.activation: Paths: prompt and template files, eval sets and eval runners, retrieval and embedding configuration, model client wrappers, judge and scorer definitions, fine-tuning or adapter configuration, anything holding a model identifier. Task types: adding or changing a model-backed feature, swapping a prompt, model, retriever or decoding setting, designing how model output is scored or accepted, diagnosing wrong or ungrounded output, migrating off a deprecated model. Predicates: calls_a_model, changes_prompt_or_model, builds_retrieval, evaluates_model_output, ships_model_output.
row.evaluation_method: packs/ai-ml-llm/CHECKS.md, plus the frozen acceptance drill in packs/ai-ml-llm/research/DRILL_PROPOSAL.md
row.estate_relevance: PatterStudio and PatterStage both ship model-backed features. This pack owns how such a feature is accepted, measured and migrated, where the agentic-development pack owns how we build with agents.
